summary_1line: Bhishma recounts how death is governed by karma and time, then begins a tale of a virtuous householder whose hospitality vow will challenge death.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kala appears before the serpent, Mrityu, and the fowler, declaring that the child's own karma caused its death.
The fire-god Agni, disguised as a Brahmana, asks King Duryodhana for the hand of the radiant princess Sudarsana.
A lone Brahmana guest asks the ashamed princess Oghavati to offer her own body in hospitality while her husband is away.
